job: keep one file or a list of files from my computer in my Files under names I choose, so the local copy can leave the disk

distinct_from.why: walks a folder on this computer and sends its files to the namespace as chunks (the folder uploader and the chunked sender). It keeps no named list, refuses no name, and writes no Files row of its own; this tool calls the records door's keepLocalFile, which uses that sender only for a file above the whole-file threshold
the writer this tool calls: one file written in pieces (keepLocalFile dispatches a large file to the sender). It reads no computer path, refuses no link or folder, and runs no list
writes the files a chat export carried through writeWholeFile under a chat's identity; it reads an export, not a file the person names on this computer
writes a recording's words beside the recording through writeWholeFile; a consumer, not a keeper of named files from the computer
documentation or the test of the writer this tool calls (records-door whole-file.mjs and its lease route), not a second keeper
